title: Good work should not require a hero every Friday
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Recognise the response — Thank the people who handled the immediate need.; Find the recurring condition — Locate the gap that made rescue necessary.; Repair the ordinary path — Assign capacity to remove or reduce the dependency.; Rehearse shared recovery — Check that the capability survives one person’s absence..
